courses.title: What is AI?
courses.description: Meet friendly robots and learn what artificial intelligence means in a fun, simple way! You'll discover how computers can learn just like we do.

courses.title: Fun with Patterns
courses.description: Play with shapes, colors, and patterns to understand how AI recognizes things. Match, sort, and have fun!

courses.title: Talking to Robots
courses.description: Learn how robots understand our words and commands. Build your own voice assistant friend!

courses.title: Robot Friends
courses.description: Explore how robots can help us in our daily lives, from cleaning up toys to helping doctors. Learn to code their emotions!

courses.title: AI Drawing Fun
courses.description: Discover how AI helper tools can draw animals and paint beautiful landscapes. Create digital artwork alongside a friendly bot!

courses.title: Smart Math Games
courses.description: Solve logic puzzle cards and count alongside an AI math companion. Make learning math numbers a playful adventure!

courses.title: Logic and Mazes
courses.description: Learn step-by-step thinking by guiding a cute digital pup through mazes. The starting line of your coding journey!

courses.title: Machine Learning Pets
courses.description: Teach a virtual cat or dog mascot to recognize voice instructions. Discover how computer brains learn from examples!

courses.title: Smart Toys
courses.description: Look at the technology inside smart teddy bears, robotic cars, and electronic games. Learn how chips think!

courses.title: AI Tells Stories
courses.description: Play with smart books that help you create magical fairy tales. Discover how machines compose fun sentences!

courses.title: Be Safe Online
courses.description: A simple introduction to keeping your information safe and being kind when interacting with digital assistants.

courses.title: Counting with AI
courses.description: Practice your counting and basic additions with interactive games managed by a smart robot teacher.

courses.title: How AI Learns
courses.description: Discover the magic behind machine learning! Teach a computer to recognize animals, fruits, and more using examples.

courses.title: Build a Chatbot
courses.description: Create your own chatbot from scratch! Learn coding basics and make a robot friend that can have real conversations.

courses.title: AI & Ethics
courses.description: Explore important questions: Should robots always obey? How do we make sure AI is fair for everyone? Think like a philosopher!

courses.title: Scratch Coding for AI
courses.description: Connect block scripts in Scratch to make games that listen to your voice or respond to your webcam moves!

courses.title: AI Image Creators
courses.description: How do tools like DALL-E draw? Learn about pixels, descriptors, and prompt engineering to guide AI artists.

courses.title: Train a Smart Mascot
courses.description: Set up data tables of characteristics (color, size, weight) to train your mascot classifier model to find special gems.

courses.title: Robotic Arms & Logic
courses.description: Write simple algorithms to command mechanical limbs to stack blocks, sort recycling, and avoid dangerous objects.

courses.title: Math in Neural Nets
courses.description: Find out how simple adding and multiplying help computer minds make decisions. It's math, but with a tech twist!

courses.title: Detecting Deepfakes
courses.description: Become a digital detective. Learn how to tell the difference between real photos and AI-made images or voice swaps.

courses.title: What is a Prompt?
courses.description: Learn what a prompt is, how computers understand our words, and how we talk to AI models using natural language!

courses.title: How to Write a Good Prompt?
courses.description: Master prompt engineering! Learn specific tips, context templates, and tricks to get the best possible answers from AI.

courses.title: Why We Need AI?
courses.description: Explore how AI solves massive real-world challenges, from predicting global weather patterns to helping doctors cure diseases.

courses.title: Machine Learning Basics
courses.description: Dive deep into supervised and unsupervised learning. Build your first ML model using real datasets and Python!

courses.title: Python for AI
courses.description: Master Python programming with NumPy, Pandas, and scikit-learn. Write real code that powers AI applications.

courses.title: AI Ethics & Society
courses.description: Analyze bias in AI systems, explore privacy concerns, and debate the future of AI governance. Critical thinking at its best.

courses.title: Intro to Neural Networks
courses.description: Understand input layers, hidden weights, and outputs. Build a visual simulation of a network learning to classify digits.

courses.title: Natural Language Processing
courses.description: Explore how Large Language Models analyze tokens, predict sentences, and generate responses. Code an basic text parser.

courses.title: Computer Vision Explorers
courses.description: Examine edge detection, convolutional kernels, and image tensors. Train a model to recognize facial gestures via camera.

courses.title: Autonomous Robotics
courses.description: Program sensor feedback loops for robotic navigation. Avoid obstacles using proximity sensors and grid maps.

courses.title: Linear Algebra for ML
courses.description: Demystify matrices, vectors, and dot products. See how these mathematical elements drive modern computer learning tools.

courses.title: AI Bias and Fairness
courses.description: Study how datasets inherit human biases. Code fairness check scripts to balance model outcomes across demographic groups.

courses.title: Reinforcement Learning & Games
courses.description: Implement Q-learning tables to train an agent to master classic arcade mazes, learning only from scores and penalties.

courses.title: Web Development with AI
courses.description: Integrate standard API connections to query AI models directly from your React/Node.js web pages. Build a complete project.

courses.title: Data Analytics & Predictions
courses.description: Clean complex CSV data, write Pandas queries, represent predictions in graphs, and compute linear regressions.
